items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Well, Zutty couldn't play it that fast. So Muscat Ramble is not a slow number the way Ori played.

ctx.x: I know he messed up the Ori band sometimes on the broadcast, playing things too fast, like Muscat Ramble. Ori couldn't even play it that fast.

Well, Zutty couldn't play it that fast. So Muscat Ramble is not a slow number the way Ori played. See? See the older them guys get, they don't try to elevate, they stay the same stage, just like Rangie was telling you last night. You don't play like they played years ago, because it's different. See? And you got to learn, you're playing the same music but you're-
They got to call it by that man Manetta, you know? So she's speaking about alluding to me, it's man Manetta. Well, that's two mangers, you know?
